anti_genericity_constraints: controlled internal knowledge assistant, not a generic public chatbot
no silent answer synthesis without citations
do not pick a default chat stack without declaring corpus boundaries, retrieval strategy, and evaluation
acceptance_criteria: internal PDFs can be ingested into a declared chunking and embedding pipeline
every supported answer includes citations to internal documents
unsupported or out-of-scope questions are refused explicitly
freshness, versioning, and stale-document behavior are defined
stack_rationale: RAG architecture with explicit ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector index, retrieval, and answer-grounding rules
internet search or external browsing fallback was rejected
security_requirements: access control by document class or audience
no leakage of sensitive text across roles
minimum metadata for audit and versioning
